# Full Knowledge Dossier — Maulana Muhammod Jainul Abidin & Meshk Prokashon

## 1. Executive Summary
- Organization: Meshk Prokashon (মেশক প্রকাশন / মেস্ক প্রকাশন)
- Slogan: বই আলো • বই সুবাস (Books are light, books are fragrance)
- Founder & Leading Author: Maulana Muhammod Jainul Abidin (মুহাম্মদ যাইনুল আবিদীন)
- Established Headquarters: Banglabazar, Dhaka, Bangladesh

## 2. Biographical Profile of Maulana Muhammod Jainul Abidin
- Date of Birth: 20 November 1967
- Place of Origin: Munshiganj, Bangladesh
- Educational Alma Mater: Darul Uloom Deoband (India) — Dawra-e-Hadith & Advanced Higher Diploma in Arabic Literature (Adab)
- Profession: Islamic Scholar, Educator, Essayist, Biographer, and Public Orator
